title: Create is blocked with zero permissions (button disabled, no message)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Create Role page with a valid Role name entered.
custom_steps:
1. Leave all permissions off.
  2. Look at the Create button.
  3. Turn on one permission.
custom_expected:
With no permissions on, the Create button is disabled and no message is shown.

Turning on at least one permission enables Create.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live role editor / roles list)
